page_title: MNU 0-1 ARS | Manchester Utd v Arsenal 17/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Simon Hooper has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Manchester Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+4' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) makes a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul. Arsenal are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90+3' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) for his blatant foul.
90+2' Arsenal take a short corner kick.
90+1' Booking. Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) receives a caution from the referee.
90+1' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
85' It's like he was asking for a caution. David Raya (Arsenal) receives a yellow card.
85' David Raya (Arsenal) attempts to delay the restart of play. The referee doesn't like it.
85' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) has tested the patience of referee Simon Hooper and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
84' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
83' The substitution is prepared. Mikel Merino (Arsenal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Declan Rice.

83' Two players stand over the free kick. Declan Rice (Arsenal) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall. The ball goes behind for a corner. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
81' Simon Hooper blows his whistle. Harry Maguire (Manchester United) commits a foul after dangerous play. It's a free kick to Arsenal, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
80' The referee signals a substitution. Harry Maguire (Manchester United) is brought on as a substitute for Luke Shaw.

78' Great solo effort by Amad Diallo (Manchester United) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
74' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by David Raya, who pulls off a stunning save!
72' Mikel Arteta has decided to make a change. Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) replaces Riccardo Calafiori.
71' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) comes onto the pitch after Ben White signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
71' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is able to continue to play.
70' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

70' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) will replace Mason Mount.
65' Casemiro comes off the pitch to be replaced by Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United).
65' Declan Rice (Arsenal) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Declan Rice (Arsenal) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
64' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
60' Here is a change. Gabriel Martinelli is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Noni Madueke (Arsenal).
60' The referee allows time for a substitution. Viktor Gyokeres will be replaced by Kai Havertz (Arsenal).
57' David Raya reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) towards the roof of the net.
56' Foul! William Saliba (Arsenal) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Manchester Utd will take a free kick near the side line.
55' We are about to witness a substitution. Amad Diallo (Manchester United) is replacing Diogo Dalot.
53' Simon Hooper blows his whistle after Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. There is a free kick near the sideline to Manchester Utd.

52' Simon Hooper blows his whistle and it's Viktor Gyokeres (Arsenal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Manchester Utd are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
49' Mason Mount (Manchester United) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
46' The whistle blows and Simon Hooper starts the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Good movement by Viktor Gyokeres (Arsenal), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is behind the touchline and Manchester Utd will take a throw-in.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
42' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
42' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Arsenal comes to nothing.
40' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Arsenal.
40' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) is penalised for a foul. Simon Hooper had a clear view and blows his whistle. Arsenal have a free kick.
38' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
36' Viktor Gyokeres (Arsenal) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.

35' A neat pass is well received by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible diving save to block his shot.

33' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his low strike to the middle of the target as David Raya produces a good save.
33' Viktor Gyokeres (Arsenal) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Gabriel Martinelli, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
30' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) tries his luck with a shot from long range, and his superb effort rattles the right post! The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
29' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
28' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

27' A pass travels right across the box to Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Altay Bayindir denies him with a decent save.
26' Manchester Utd take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

25' Wow, what an escape. Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
22' Arsenal hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
21' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) is adjudged offside.
20' Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Arsenal are awarded a free kick.
19' Declan Rice (Arsenal) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Altay Bayindir.
18' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) makes a slide tackle, but referee Simon Hooper blows for a foul. Arsenal win a free kick.
17' A poorly taken free kick by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall.
16' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) commits a rough foul. Simon Hooper stops the game and makes a call. Manchester Utd have a free kick from a promising distance.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 0:1.
13' Declan Rice (Arsenal) will deliver the corner kick.
13' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Arsenal win a corner kick.
12' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
10' Manchester Utd fail to score from a corner as David Raya (Arsenal) leaps to collect the ball.
9' Referee Simon Hooper sees the trip by William Saliba (Arsenal) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. That's a free kick to Manchester Utd.

8' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.

6' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. David Raya guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
5' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
4' Ben White (Arsenal) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Simon Hooper signals. Manchester Utd earn a free kick.
1' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Simon Hooper will officiate today.
